ORIGIN ACTIVATION KEY FIX FOR WINDOWS 10
I discovered that a Xbox Game Pass Ultimate subscription is REQUIRED for this fix.
Edit: 09/23/2023

I recently had to reinstall this game because of swapping from a SSD to a M.2 and I ran into an window on launch asking me for a Activation Code for Origin. After a bit of research on Google, it appears that this is actually a widespread issue since around May. This was the fix for me.

1. Uninstall Mass Effect 3 from Steam, (I did not use a uninstaller program like REVO Uninstaller). Just find Mass Effect 3 in your library, right click and select Manage>Uninstall.

2. Open the EA App and click on Library>Mass Effect 3>Install.

3. Launch Mass Effect 3 from EA App and get to the main menu. Ignore a missing DLC Error. Exit the Game from the Main Menu option.

4. Return to Steam and Install Mass Effect 3 from Steam to the same drive as the version from the EA App. DO NOT Uninstall the version from the EA App. (Yes, I know the game is now installed twice, we will deal with this later.)

5. Launch Mass Effect 3 via Steam and get to the main menu. Exit the Game from the Main Menu option.

6. Right click on Start, choose Apps and Features.

7. Uninstall Mass Effect 3.         DO NOT UNINSTALL "Mass Effect 3 N7 Digital Deluxe Edition (2012) as this is the Steam Version!!!

8. Return to Steam and Launch Mass Effect 3. The EA App will give an Error. Just click Ok. Mass Effect 3 will not open.

9. Right-Click on Mass Effect 3 in Steam and choose Properties<Installed Files<Verify integrity of game files. Steam will now update Mass Effect 3 for 21.9 GB.

10. Mass Effect 3 now launches correctly for me from Steam and all DLC are loaded.
